description: The bar chart, titled "Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment," illustrates a runtime comparison between an ensemble model and various Large Language Models (LLMs) on the SEconvo dataset. The horizontal axis contains the categories, displaying five models: "Our Joint Framework," "ChatGPT," "DeepSeek," "LLaMA," and "Claude," with labels tilted slightly and arranged without a specific sorting order. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Runtime (seconds)," using a linear scale that ranges from 0 to 400 with a tick label interval of 50. Light gray dashed horizontal gridlines extend across the chart area. A legend in the top left corner indicates that dark green represents "Our Joint Framework" and light blue represents "LLM Models." Each bar is outlined in black and features a bold numerical annotation above it indicating its exact value. The shortest bar corresponds to "Our Joint Framework" at 77 seconds, which is visually emphasized by its distinct dark green color. The remaining four bars are colored light blue, representing the LLM models: "ChatGPT" has a value of 190, "DeepSeek" is the tallest bar at 365, "LLaMA" is at 172, and "Claude" is at 243.
